title: Witch on the Holy Night Film Reveals 'Double Visual,' Game's Smartphone Version with Same-Day Release as Film
content: The Mahōtsukai no Yoru ( Witch on the Holy Night ) anime film stage presentation at the FGO Fes. 2026 event on Saturday revealed the film's "double visual" drawn by Type-Moon and ufotable .

title: Chained Soldier Season 3 Anime Announced
content: Chained Soldier Season 3 anime was officially announced during a special event that took place in Japan today on August 2. Masafumi Tamura directed the second season at Passione x Hayabusa Film.
author: Anime Corner

title: Dark Gathering Manga Takes 1-Month Break
content: Kondō ( Cheer Danshi!! GO BREAKERS manga) launched the manga in Jump SQ. in March 2019. Shueisha published the manga's 20th compiled book volume on July 3. Viz Media licensed the manga and released the 18th volume on June 2.
author: ANN

title: SuBLime Licenses Robin at the Break of Dawn, Cake Dog Caramelized, Welcome to the Tiger Detective Agency for 2027 Release
content: Viz Media 's SuBLime imprint for boys-love manga announced on X (formerly Twitter ) on Saturday (August 1 is Yaoi Day in Japan) that it has licensed three new manga for English digital and print release in 2027.
author: ANN

title: Prime Video India Expands CJ ENM Partnership, to Stream More Than 100 Korean Titles
content: Prime Video India has signed a multi-year licensing agreement with CJ ENM to bring more than 100 Korean titles to audiences in India, including 26 new series scheduled to roll out over the next two years.
author: ANN

title: Chiikawa Anime Film Opens in Malaysia on August 20
content: Malaysian cinema chain GSC Movies began streaming a trailer for Eiga Chiikawa: Ningyo no Shima no Himitsu ( Chiikawa the Movie: The Secret of Mermaid Island), the first anime film adaptation of Nagano 's Chiikawa manga, on Thursday.

title: Even the Student Council Has its Holes! Anime Casts Shizuka Ishigami
content: The staff for the television anime of Muchimaro 's Even the Student Council Has Its Holes! ( Seitokai ni mo Ana wa Aru! ) four-panel manga revealed the character promotional video, character visual, and cast for the character Arisu Terui, on Saturday. Shizuka Ishigami will voice the character.
